papers.title: Longitudinal fMRI reveals multi-network reconfiguration and a recurrent frontoparietal shift across rest and task states during adult aging
papers.reason: Longitudinal human fMRI evidence on aging-related frontoparietal network reconfiguration across rest and executive-memory task states is relevant to modelling cognitive control and aging, though it is not itself a cognitive process model.

papers.title: NeuroAct: Advancing EEG Analysis and Decoding via Dual-Loop Autonomous Research
papers.reason: The paper proposes a general autonomous framework for EEG decoding with some relevance to cognitive workload and clinical EEG classification, but its core contribution is an AI-assisted EEG pipeline rather than executive-function modelling or assessment.

papers.title: Mapping the Research Landscape and Global Trends: A Bibliometric Analysis of Event-related Potential in Alzheimer's Disease.
papers.reason: A bibliometric review of ERP research in Alzheimer's disease is broadly related to EEG biomarkers for cognitive impairment but does not appear to provide primary executive-function findings or a computational model.
